title: Safeguards for Employers Who Make Advance Salary Payments for Their Foreign Domestic Workers to Settle Loans
what_it_is: Safeguards for Employers Who Make Advance Salary Payments for Their Foreign Domestic Workers to Settle Loans

sections.label: EA disclosure and refund rules
sections.summary: EAs must disclose service terms, FDW charges and refund policies on advance salary payments by employers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To protect employers and FDWs, EAs are required by law to fully disclose the terms and conditions of their services, including the amount FDWs are charged and their refund policies on advance salary payments by employers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In the event that the employer terminates the FDW employment contract early and sends the FDW back to the EA, or the FDW commits an offence and has to be repatriated, the EA would usually refund any outstanding advance salary payment made by the employer.

sections.label: MOM action against EAs
sections.summary: Since 2016, MOM investigated and acted against two EAs that failed to state their refund policies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Since 2016, MOM had investigated and taken actions against two EAs that had failed to state their refund policies.

sections.label: EA fee caps and penalties
sections.summary: MOM sets fee caps limiting EA charges to FDWs, with prosecution or licence revocation for flouting them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, we need to think through the suggestion very carefully.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: I want to say that MOM has put in place fee caps to regulate what an EA can charge the FDW, and that is important because that may then manifest itself as advance salary payment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And EAs are not allowed to collect fees that exceed FDWs' monthly salary for each year of contracted service.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: EAs who flout this rule may be prosecuted or even have their licences revoked.

sections.label: MOM jurisdiction over overseas EAs
sections.summary: MOM cannot regulate home-country EAs but will investigate shared information and enlist Embassy help.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: While MOM will undertake all the necessary efforts to prohibit our Singapore-based EAs from charging the FDWs beyond the fee cap, we must also explain that we have no jurisdiction over the EA in the home country of the FDW.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Having said that, for the case that Mr Murali Pillai's resident is facing, if he could share with us the information, that would be most helpful.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: We will then be able to investigate this further and, if we find any suspicious or irregular practices, we can follow up with the relevant Embassy and enlist their help so that we can stop the malpractice at source.
